summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for Spring Boot 3.0 Batch Processing migration with no semantic overlap to existing skills (which are Flink streaming execution skills in different domain). Peer candidates are sibling Spring Boot 3.0 migration skills (Build Tool, Security, Session Management) at same asset_level and stage, confirming this is a legitimate new capability in the Spring Boot migration workflow family. Single support evidence from Spring Boot 3.0 Migration Guide validates the guidance.
